description: manni docs meta/reference/configuration, run in a repo whose manni.config.yaml is the 0.3.0 form the migration section starts from.

steps.description: The 0.3.0 config is refused, naming where the key went.

runShell.stdio: "paths" is no longer a meta key. Document sets are declared once for every tool, under a top-level collections: list.

steps.description: Migrate: write the 1.0.0 form of the config.

runShell.command:
node -e "require('fs').writeFileSync('manni.config.yaml','collections:
  - name: pages
    paths: [\x22docs/**/*.md\x22]
    exclude: [\x22docs/drafts/**\x22]
    externalMetadata:
      - file: ./docs-meta.yaml
        keys: [source, jira]
  - name: guides
    paths: [\x22docs/guides/**\x22]

meta:
  overrides:
    - collection: guides
      schemas: [./schemas/guide.json]
')"

steps.description: With the collections in place, a bare run reads every collection; the drafts stay out.
--collection narrows the run to one collection.
Two collections, one name per occurrence.
An unknown collection name is a usage error.

runShell.stdio: --collection selects a configured collection; it cannot be combined with paths.
--collection needs a config file to select from.
